description_en: Updates the recording plan for intelligent alert events
description_zh: 调用该接口更新智能告警事件录像计划
name: UpdateEventRecordPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the intelligent alert event recording plan. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107907.html to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 智能告警事件录像计划ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107907.html查询
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the intelligent alert event recording plan.

The name must be less than 48 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:)
parameters.help_zh:
智能告警事件录像名称。

名称长度小于48个字符，可以包含英文字母、数字和特殊字符：短划线（-）、下划线（_）、at（@）、英文句号（.）、英文冒号（:）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The intelligent alert event types.

To specify all intelligent alert event types, set this parameter to 0.
To specify multiple intelligent alert event types, enter the serial numbers of the event types separated by commas (,). Example: `10001,10002`.
You can specify up to 10 intelligent alert event types at a time.

To view all intelligent alert event types, go to the Define Feature tab on the Product Details page in the IoT Platform console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207701.html
parameters.help_zh:
智能告警事件类型：

设置为全部智能告警事件：0。
设置为多个智能告警事件：输入智能告警事件对应的序号，并用英文逗号（,）分隔，例如：`10001,10002`。
设置多个智能告警事件时，单次最多支持设置10个。

请在物联网平台控制台，产品详情页面的功能定义页签，查看全部智能告警事件类型。详细信息，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207701.html
parameters.name: event_types

parameters.help_en:
The pre-recording duration. Valid values: 0 to 10. Unit: seconds.

The pre-recording duration is generated only when the device supports the pre-recording feature. Otherwise, the pre-recording duration is 0
parameters.help_zh:
预录时长，取值范围0~10，单位为秒。

设备具备预录功能时，才可生成预录时长，否则，预录时长为0
parameters.name: pre_record_duration

parameters.help_en: The recording duration, including the pre-recording duration. Valid values: 10 to 60. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 录像时长，包括预录时长，取值范围10~60，单位为秒
parameters.name: record_duration

parameters.help_en: The ID of the time template. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107890.html to query the ID
parameters.name: template_id

Code.description_en:
The response code. Valid values:

200: The request was successful.
Other values: An error occurred. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145071.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
